_comment: The picture-in-picture dispatch sequence, as ONE document run by both
sides of a lane boundary (M2-05).
Model.js BUILDS these argv vectors (lane V1) and scripts/dev-harness/
stub-hyprctl.py PARSES them (lane V2). That is one interface with two
implementations and nothing comparing them: every assertion about the
builder ran against strings written in tests/Model.test.js, and every
assertion about the fake compositor ran against strings written by hand
in tests/test_pip.py. Both suites could stay green with the two halves
unable to speak to each other, and the only runner that would have
noticed is the live harness half, which needs a display.
So: tests/Model.test.js asserts Model.pipPlan emits exactly these
vectors, and tests/test_pip.py replays these same vectors through the
stub and asserts the window reaches `after`. A change to the expression
grammar on either side now turns one of the two red.
The numbers are the M2-05-00 gate's own transcript against a live
compositor (docs/QA-RESULTS.md): a player tiled at [690, 38] 650x718 on
eDP-1, entering PiP at [940, 42] 410x230 and coming back byte-identical.
The steps are design 4.3 as ruling PIP10 corrects it: no `action` field
anywhere, and on the way out the tag goes first and the unpin comes
before the unfloat.
ASCII only: scripts/check.sh greps tests/fixtures/* for non-ASCII bytes.
From the box back to the layout, with the snapshot saying the window
was TILED before PiP - so no resize and no move, which is why the
unpin has to come first: unfloating a pinned window clears the pin by
itself and the layout hands the old rectangle back.
